question: If you switched around the spirits and bodies of the royal selection members (and at first, no one noticed), when the owner of the body spoke with their knight, what conversation from which pair would be most interesting?
answer: Ferris would get a nosebleed from Crusch-sama’s body and pass out, Al would play with Priscilla’s chest, a new blond loli of justice would show up in the town, pretty much all of them would be interesting.
